QuestInfo.name: [Erel Light] Journey for the Future
QuestInfo.0: It's time to introduce everyone to the friends who helped you on your way.
QuestInfo.1: There are places without even the blessing of the Star Creator to protect them...places that need you. Tell everyone what you plan to do.
QuestInfo.2: You left for the wider world, determined help people to ward off the darkness without relying on the blessing of the Star Creator.
